summary: Quiet, cooperative week: the July 15-31 invoice went out Aug 1 and Liza confirmed on Aug 6 that she had already paid Derrek in crypto (within the 7-day window), though Stephski was chasing it unaware of the side-channel payment. The one open item is her Aug 6 OnlyFans 'tag a creator' flag question, which was escalated internally (@roflo1424) but she had received no answer by week's end - a repeat of the collab-tag flags she raised back in January. Mood remains warm and appreciative, with mild friction around payment reconciliation and unanswered platform questions.
